description: Authorizes retrieval of enterprise documents after validating requester authorization, document access permissions, data classification, and retrieval risk assessment.

unboundSignalReasons.requesterAuthenticated: Attested by the identity provider at authentication time; not a value the Intent itself declares.
unboundSignalReasons.requesterAuthorized: Result of an independent authorization check against the requester's entitlements; not something the Intent's target/parameters could express.
unboundSignalReasons.documentAccessible: Result of an independent document-availability check; not a value the Intent itself declares.
unboundSignalReasons.classificationPermitted: Result of comparing the requester's clearance to the document's classification, independently verified; not an Intent field.
unboundSignalReasons.riskScore: A computed retrieval-risk score, not a value the caller's Intent declares or could be checked against.

outcome.reason: Document access authorized. Authentication, authorization, document permissions, classification requirements, and risk assessment were satisfied.
Document access rejected because the assessed retrieval risk exceeds the maximum permitted threshold.
Document access rejected because the requested document is not accessible.
Document access rejected because the requester is not authorized to access the document's classification level.
Document access rejected because one or more required policy conditions were not satisfied.
